contrary_evidence: China official manufacturing PMI 49.3 contracted while RatingDog private PMI 52.0 expanded, reflecting different survey populations rather than a homogeneous China reading.
Korea/Japan/Taiwan PMIs remained above 50 even as their momentum weakened; a regional recession is not established.
Korean non-semiconductor exports grew 34% in nominal terms despite the concentration of chip revenue.
US Q3 real GDP +3.4% annualized and euro-area Q3 +0.4% q/q are positive on distinct time bases.
OPEC unchanged required production cannot establish actual December delivered barrels or absence of shipping risk.
30 Oct US equity selloff does not measure Monday 2 Nov close or prove AI capex unprofitable.
limitations: Original subscription S&P Global country PMI reports were not independently accessed; first-hand Reuters coverage of those releases was checked and timed before the stated cutoff.
Primary-source verification sampled material quantitative and policy claims, not all 20 documents or every qualitative sentence.
PMI readings, nominal customs receipts and physical production cannot be transformed into a common growth rate; no chip quantity/customer-return data are provided.
The IMF 2026–27 GDP values are forecasts, not realized growth, and 30 Oct equity returns are not 2 Nov closes.

contrary_evidence: China official PMI 49.3 signals contraction in official survey while private RatingDog 52.0 indicates expansion: different populations and sectors, neither can erase the other.
South Korean manufacturing PMI 51.3 represents slower expansion, not an observed 2.6% fall in national factory output.
Korean October semiconductor receipts $56.44bn grew 259.4% nominally, but nonchip exports also grew 34%, arguing against both a broad collapse and an exclusively technology-led expansion.
Japan PMI 53.3 and Taiwan 54.9 remain above 50 although decelerating, so a synchronized Asian recession is not evidenced.
IMF regional GDP projection remains 4.8% in 2026 while falling to 4.4% in 2027; declines in PMI momentum do not establish a current recession.
Official OPEC+ December required output unchanged does not prove delivered barrels, shipping normality or a peace agreement.
Friday 30 Oct US equity index declines are not an observed Monday 2 Nov close; capital expenditure profitability cannot be inferred solely from prices.
BoJ Oct30 maintained 1.25%; potential future increase is a scenario, not an implemented 2 Nov rate change.
limitations: Cutoff 05:00 UTC on Nov2; US ISM and European Monday PMIs, US closing stock prices, later statements and US elections of Nov3 are not observed.
PMI diffusion measures are not comparable to nominal customs values or physical production growth; sample-composition detail is incomplete.
Reuters PMI descriptions used where original subscription-only S&P country reports cannot be publicly inspected, marked as a source-limited verification.
Oil quotas do not establish compliance or delivered oil volumes; 14 Oct IEA data describe September not 2 Nov movements.
Financial market benchmark percentage moves are the Friday 30 Oct closed session, not realtime Nov2 pricing.
Household energy pass-through, business credit spreads and investment profitability require independent account-level and sectoral evidence.
